transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to discuss the late bus plan for Central High School's after-school tutoring program. As you know, I'll be making the final decision on the operating plan, but I want to get input from both our transportation operations and family engagement teams before I approve anything. Let's start by reviewing the draft — it currently proposes service on Mondays and Wednesdays, departure at 4:30 p.m., a 40-seat bus, and a drop-off at Main Library. The draft also allows any student remaining for a school-sponsored after-school activity to ride. I'd like to hear your thoughts on whether this plan meets our students' needs and if there are any operational concerns we should address.
